name: Grand Parade Investments Limited
source: Audited consolidated annual financial statements FY2026 (year ended 30 June 2026), Grand Parade Investments Limited; figures converted from ZAR thousands to rand. Operating profit includes profit from equity accounted investments of 78,280 thousand and impairment of associates of 10,061 thousand, which are the operating income of an investment holding company. Revenue is dividend and board fee income only, so margin ratios are withheld as not meaningful. No cost of sales line exists. No capital expenditure line was presented, so Capital Expenditure and Free Cash Flow are left empty. FY2025 column replaced with the audited comparative because the earlier secondary feed carried an operating loss against a profit before tax.
